## lucide-animated

Copy, bookmark, and bell SVGs and gesture concepts in `animated-icon.tsx` are adapted from https://github.com/pqoqubbw/icons. Polli adjusts timing, movement, and triggers and uses CSS in place of the original Motion implementation.
